test_worker.title: Test worker
test_worker.desc: Worker name the pool check (the Test button and the check before a switch) authorizes with. It may stay in the pool dashboard as an inactive worker.

switch_drain.title: Reconnect window
switch_drain.desc: How long the proxy spreads out disconnecting miners on a pool switch, a failback and “Reconnect all”. Longer is gentler on the pool, but part of the farm stays on the old pool longer. 0 means all at once.

failback_delay.title: Failback delay
failback_delay.desc: How long the active pool must stay healthy before miners return to it from a fallback pool. Prevents flapping when the pool is unstable.

pool_probe_interval.title: Pool check interval
pool_probe_interval.desc: How often the proxy checks every address of every pool (connect and mining.subscribe, no authorization) and measures the connect time. More often detects an outage sooner but connects to pools more.

tls_handshake_timeout.title: TLS handshake timeout
tls_handshake_timeout.desc: How long to wait for an ASIC to finish the TLS handshake on the TLS port before closing the connection.

first_message_timeout.title: First message timeout
first_message_timeout.desc: How long to wait for the first Stratum message after an ASIC connects. Protects against connections that send nothing. The proxy connects to the pool only after this message.

upstream_dial_timeout.title: Pool connect timeout
upstream_dial_timeout.desc: How long to wait for a connection (and TLS handshake) to one pool address before trying the next address or a fallback pool.

upstream_connect_budget.title: Total pool search time
upstream_connect_budget.desc: How long a session may try addresses and pools in total. If none answers, the ASIC connection is closed and the ASIC reconnects by itself.

miner_idle_timeout.title: ASIC idle timeout
miner_idle_timeout.desc: If an ASIC sends nothing for longer than this, the session is closed.

upstream_idle_timeout.title: Pool idle timeout
upstream_idle_timeout.desc: If the pool sends nothing for longer than this, the session is closed and the ASIC reconnects. Too small a value breaks sessions on pools that rarely send jobs.

max_connections.title: Total connections
max_connections.desc: How many ASIC connections the proxy holds at once (TCP and TLS together). Extra ones are closed right away. Lowering the value does not disconnect miners already connected.

max_pending_connections.title: Connections awaiting first message
max_pending_connections.desc: How many connections may wait for their first Stratum message at the same time. Protects against slow-connection attacks.

max_conn_per_ip.title: Connections per IP
max_conn_per_ip.desc: Limit of connections from one address; 0 turns it off. ⚠ A whole farm usually reaches the internet from one IP: if you enable it, set it well above the number of ASICs.

max_line_bytes.title: Maximum message size
max_line_bytes.desc: If a single Stratum message (from an ASIC or a pool) is longer, the session is closed. Rarely needs changing.

tls_min_version.title: Minimum TLS version
tls_min_version.desc: The oldest TLS version the TLS port accepts. Lower it only if an old firmware cannot connect otherwise: 1.0 and 1.1 are insecure.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.desc: How detailed the container logs are. debug is for troubleshooting: details of every session, the log volume grows a lot. Passwords are never logged at any level.

history_detail_retention.title: Detailed history
history_detail_retention.desc: How long per-minute statistics are kept. Charts for up to 3 days are drawn from them; longer periods use hourly points. Takes about 0.3–0.5 MB per day with a few pools.

history_retention.title: History retention
history_retention.desc: How long hourly statistics are kept for long-range charts. Takes about 10 KB per day, so years of history fit easily.

profit_switch.title: Profit switching
profit_switch.desc: On schedule the proxy compares the coins of the pools marked “Take part in profit switching”: network difficulty, block reward with fees and price, 24-hour averages from WhatToMine. Advise only shows what earns more; Auto makes the most profitable pool active, with the same pool check as a manual switch. An active pool that does not take part is left alone.

profit_interval.title: Profitability check interval
profit_interval.desc: How often to compare the coins and decide. More often reacts sooner to difficulty and price changes, but miners reconnect more often, and on PPLNS pools frequent switching loses income.

profit_margin.title: Switching margin
profit_margin.desc: How much more another coin must earn than the current one to switch to it. Protects against switching on noise: BTC and BCH usually differ by only 1–3%.

history_miner_retention.title: Miner history
history_miner_retention.desc: How long the hourly statistics of every miner (hashrate, shares, time online) are kept. The detailed history also has ten-minute points. Grows with the farm: about 1.3 KB a day per miner hourly and 8 KB detailed.

timed_switch.title: Timed switching
timed_switch.desc: At the start of every period the farm moves to the pool marked “Switch to this pool on the timer” in the pool editor, for example a solo pool, and after the set time returns to the pool and fallback order it had before. Every switch reconnects all miners within the reconnect window. If the timer pool fails its check, the farm stays where it is until the next period. A pool chosen by hand during that time stays.

timed_period.title: Timer period
timed_period.desc: How often the farm moves to the timer pool. The time on it starts at multiples of the period: every 30 minutes means at :00 and :30.

timed_duration.title: Time on the timer pool
timed_duration.desc: How long the farm mines on the timer pool in every period; shorter than the period. 10 minutes every 30 minutes is a third of the hashrate.

server.title: Server
server.help: Read only. These values are set in .env on the server and apply after docker compose up -d: changing a port from the UI would break Docker port publishing, and a mistake in the password would lock you out.
